subject: Throughput offset claim and credit proposal for Cyclone AI incident (Feb 12)
body:
-----Original Message-----
From: Alex Park <alex.park@cycloneai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: SLA credit eligibility after Feb 12 throughput degradation

Hi Neha,

Thanks for the incident updates earlier this week. Cyclone AI saw a sustained throughput degradation on Feb 12 (roughly 02:10 - 05:40 UTC) that impacted inference tail latency and request throughput for several production routes. Our engineering team pulled SLIs and we believe the customer-facing availability for the account dropped below the SLA threshold for that billing period.

Can you confirm whether this qualifies for a service credit under our contract and, if so, provide the calculation you plan to use (minutes/hours, % credit, and dollar amount against Feb invoice)? We will need a formal statement to submit to our finance team.

I can attach the SLI snippets if useful — sending now.

Thanks,
Alex Park
Head of Platform Reliability
Cyclone AI

Attachment: sli_export_feb12.csv

----
On Fri, 13 Feb 2026 10:03:00 -0800 Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com> wrote:

Hi Alex — thanks for the note and for sending the SLI export. We are reviewing the data now. A couple of quick asks to speed this through:

- Can you confirm the contracting entity and whether there is a committed monthly spend (we use this to compute % of invoice where applicable).
- Do you want the credit applied as a one-time invoice adjustment or as a recurring offset on the next billing cycle?

I will loop in billing and operations to produce a formal calculation and our incident report.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com

----
From: Alex Park <alex.park@cycloneai.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Feb 2026 11:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: SLA credit eligibility after Feb 12 throughput degradation

Neha,

Cyclone AI (contracting entity: Cyclone AI, Inc.) has monthly committed spend on Redwood Dedicated $45,000 (committed). We would prefer a one-time invoice adjustment to February rather than a recurring offset.

I've attached the SLI export (same file shared earlier) and a short note from our ops team pointing to the affected routes: /v1/rl-infer, /v1/conv-decode.

Attachment: sli_export_feb12.csv

Thanks — Alex

----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Sun, 15 Feb 2026 14:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Fwd: SLA credit eligibility for Cyclone AI — need calc + approval

Team — forwarding Cyclone's request. Summary of incident (ops): partial throughput degradation on Feb 12 between 02:10 - 05:40 UTC (3.5 hours of elevated latencies and reduced throughput for two routes). Per their contract (SLA section 4.2) the remedy is a service credit based on the % of downtime during the billing period applied to the committed spend.

Please see the attached SLI export. Can billing confirm calculation approach and finance sign off on invoice adj? Marcus, can ops provide a short incident write-up we can share with the customer (timeline + mitigation)?

I propose we follow the SLA formula: credit % = min(10%, floor((downtime minutes / total minutes in month) * 100 * 10) / 10) — basically compute share of monthly minutes and map to SLA bands. I ran a quick calc: Feb (28 days) = 40,320 minutes; incident = 210 minutes -> 0.52% of month. Under the SLA bands that results in a 5% service credit on committed monthly amount. 5% of $45,000 = $2,250.

Requesting approvals:
- Marissa: sales approval to issue 5% credit and finalize as one-time Feb invoice adjustment.
- Dylan: instruct finance on posting the credit and issuing a credit memo.
- Marcus: finalize incident report for customer.

Thanks,
Neha

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 16 Feb 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SLA credit eligibility for Cyclone AI — need calc + approval

Neha — approved. The quick calc looks correct and 5% is within standard precedent for this band of impact. Please confirm the exact credit memo wording; we will mark as 'Service Credit - Feb 2026 incident (Cyclone AI)'.

Dylan — please proceed with issuing a one-time invoice adjustment and create a credit memo for $2,250 to apply to the Feb invoice. Include reference: Deal HB-4723-CYCLONE.

Marcus — please attach the incident report (timeline, root cause, mitigation, and follow-ups). We should include a short "what we're doing to prevent recurrence" bullet list.

Marissa Cole
Director, Sales - Enterprise
marissa_cole@redwood.com

----
From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
To: Alex Park <alex.park@cycloneai.com>, Priya Sharma <priya@cycloneai.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.com, marcus_lin@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 20 Feb 2026 11:03:00 -08:00
Subject: RE: SLA credit eligibility after Feb 12 throughput degradation — credit issued

Hi Alex / Priya — following up with the outcome from Redwood. Thank you for the SLI export and your patience while we coordinated internally.

Summary and next steps:
- Eligibility: Confirmed eligible under SLA section 4.2 for a one-time invoice adjustment.
- Calculation: Incident window 2026-02-12 02:10 - 05:40 UTC = 210 minutes. February (28 days) = 40,320 minutes. Downtime share = 210 / 40,320 = 0.52% of month. Per SLA banding this maps to a 5% service credit.
- Dollar amount: 5% of committed monthly spend ($45,000) = $2,250.
- Credit issuance: Finance has posted a credit memo #CM-20260220-4723 for $2,250 and applied it as a one-time adjustment to the Feb 2026 invoice. You should see the credit reflected on the customer portal and on the emailed invoice within 24 hours.

Attached: credit_calc_feb2026.xlsx (calculation tab + witness SLI timestamps), incident_report_feb12.pdf (ops timeline + mitigations).

If you'd like a brief call to walk through the incident report or the calculation, I'm happy to set one up. Otherwise we'll consider this resolved and will close the incident ticket on our side after you confirm receipt.

Thanks again,
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Manager, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.com
Mobile: +1 415-555-0189

Attachment: credit_calc_feb2026.xlsx, incident_report_feb12.pdf
